title: Software Engineers Beware: Stop Resisting AI
description: People are already getting fired for resisting AI, and one basic feature in the Claude app can help keep you off that layoff line without touching your code base.

I walk through the internal tools, dashboards, system design diagrams, clickable prototypes and living docs you can build with it in minutes and share with your team by link, plus why the usual objections from AI skeptics do not hold up.
